title: exactly N hops: the shortest distance is N
notes: YYC reaches NRT directly and through YVR; at a shortest distance of exactly 2 it reaches only KIX. `code` is unique, so the far end is pinned and searched from both ends (zega#86).

knownFailure.reason: zegadb/zega#86: the pinned engine (2b5ebd2) has no chains or hop bands; this case records its outcome until the pin moves.
